security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU's TCG translation or helper for vadd.vv (and potentially other vector ALU instructions) iterates over vlmax = (VLEN>>LMUL)>>SEW elements instead of the CSR vl value, writing computed results into destination vector register elements beyond the configured vector length. This corrupts tail elements that the guest expects to remain either undisturbed (vtype.vta=0) or agnostic (all-1s), breaking the architectural contract where only vl elements are written.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: Vector instruction helper or translator using max_elems or vlmax derived from vext_get_vlmax() as the element loop bound instead of env->vl or desc vlenb-derived actual vl; specifically any loop head containing 'i < vlmax' 'i < max_elems' or equivalent where vlmax != vl, in target/riscv/vector_helper.c or target/riscv/insn_trans/trans_rvv.c.inc
security_spec.summary: Using vlmax instead of vl as vector element loop bound writes past vl into tail elements, corrupting destination register state beyond the configured element count
